description: §14.8.9 S441 round 3 (N1) — the ordinary index-by idiom `rows.reduce((acc, r) => { acc[r.passwordHash] = r.id; return acc }, {})` puts every protected value into the result as a KEY. `o[k] = v` carries the key's provenance into `o`: E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED by the round-2 review (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar): member assignment dropped the key's provenance, so this compiled and served every hash as a key. Indexing by a non-protected column (acc[r.name]) stays clean.
